modelPlan.focus: Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of students doing part-time jobs, focusing on aspects like work-life balance, skill development, and financial independence.
outline: Introduction: Present the topic and state the need to explore both sides.
Body 1: Advantages - Professional development, financial aid, time management.
Body 2: Disadvantages - Time constraints, impact on studies, potential burnout.
Conclusion: Summarize the points and provide a balanced view.
keyArguments: Part-time jobs provide students with valuable professional experience and financial support.
However, they can lead to time management issues and may negatively affect academic performance.
